motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and selected state feedback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(58% 0.19 255); color: oklch(100% 0.003 255); border: 0; border-radius: 9px; padding: 7px 12px; font: 550 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(52% 0.18 255); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(58% 0.19 255); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.css: .ds-input-search { width: 360px; height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(88% 0.012 255); border-radius: 12px; background: oklch(100% 0.003 255); color: oklch(25% 0.012 255); font: 400 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-input-search:focus { outline: none; border-color: oklch(58% 0.19 255); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(58% 0.19 255 / 0.18); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Visible removable state for an active search constraint.
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { border: 1px solid oklch(78% 0.08 255); border-radius: 999px; padding: 5px 9px; background: oklch(94% 0.035 255); color: oklch(38% 0.14 255); font: 550 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-filter-chip:hover { background: oklch(91% 0.05 255); } .ds-filter-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(58% 0.19 255); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A fast, quiet, trustworthy macOS utility that puts search, sort, filters, and direct file actions within one glance.

rules.name: Functional Accent
rules.body: Blue indicates action, focus, selection, or active state and is never decorative.

rules.name: Flat at Rest
rules.body: Persistent surfaces use tonal separation; shadows belong to transient hierarchy.

dos: Keep plain text search as the default.
donts: Do not expose query syntax in the standard search field.
Do not block the interface while sorting a full result set.
